why_it_matters: Preprocessing differences can masquerade as estimator differences.
Estimator sophistication cannot fix severe support problems.
ATE accuracy and CATE ranking are different objectives.
Overall metrics can hide subgroup failures.
The best estimator must also be maintainable and rerunnable.
The best choice depends on data support, assumptions, and the downstream decision.
